decisions.reason: As a distributor of finishing equipment, the firm carries a cutting and creasing finisher with its own product page at low cost, and the product fits its core portfolio, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search.
The UV spot varnishing system received a prominent German premiere and home-page placement, which signals strong management commitment and early market interest that meets aspirations.
The sheet preparation module is a modest add-on that complements the system offering, and slack in a wholesale catalogue makes it cheap to carry while its results are still uncertain.
The B2 multifinisher was launched with home-page news as a new solution category, so management likely sees it meeting aspirations and continues to invest in it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's postpress portfolio, and with no sign of underperformance a boundedly rational distributor keeps it listed.
The folding unit already shows a documented customer installation that combines it with an existing line, which confirms performance and supports keeping it.
